verdict.rationale: Riveter lets developers shape output by building an enrichment from a "structured spec" or by passing a list of named attributes (e.g. "CEO", "Employee Count") that become filled columns, so callers can get structured, column-shaped results. Nothing in the evidence shows it accepting an actual JSON schema with types, nesting or validation, or guaranteeing schema-conformant output. Missing for 10: explicit JSON-schema input parameter, typed/nested field definitions, documented schema validation or conformance guarantees, independent corroboration.
